verdict.rationale: Letta lets you decide where agent data lives by choosing a deployment model. The default local mode keeps agent state on your machine with no login [letta-docs-31, letta-docs-74]. You can self-host on infrastructure you control [letta-docs-30, letta-docs-15], or opt into Letta Cloud via `backend: "cloud"` or `/login` [letta-docs-46, letta-docs-9]. This is coarse control (local vs. self-hosted vs. vendor cloud), not region or residency selection; shared memory, for example, is only hosted in Letta Cloud [letta-docs-21]. Missing for 10: selectable cloud regions/data-residency options for Letta Cloud, documented residency or compliance guarantees, independent corroboration.
